connector.name: Yandex Metrica MCP by BoxLab-Ltd
connector.registryDescription: Query Yandex Metrica analytics - reports, trends, metadata and raw log exports - via an AI agent.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package yandex-metrica-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the boxlab-ltd account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: YANDEX_METRIKA_TOKEN
env.description: Yandex Metrica OAuth token (metrika:read). Optional if you run the `auth` login.

env.name: YANDEX_METRIKA_COUNTER_ID
env.description: Default counter id, so tools may omit counterId.

env.name: YANDEX_METRIKA_LOGS_DIR
env.description: Directory for Logs API file exports (logs_download in file mode). Defaults to a folder under the OS temp directory.
